text: 61 A boy went walking 4.1 One day a boy went walking And walked into a store. He bought a pack of pencils And laid them on the floor. The boy began to whistle He whistled up a tune. And all the little pencils Danced around the room. 1. Listen and sing. 2. Read and say. store began bought whistle laid floor pack tune little danced around walked UNIT FOUR
